description_for_human: Search domain availability and compare prices across 6 registrars. Get detailed domain intelligence.
description_for_model: Search for domain name availability across 6 registrars (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Dynadot, Hover, Name.com, Porkbun) with live pricing. Find the cheapest registrar for any domain. Also look up detailed domain intelligence (RDAP, DNS) for any registered domain.
